description: Calling retry_request() twice can cause the same payment to be processed more than once. Find the cause and fix it.
bug_patch:
diff --git a/src/payment/retry.py b/src/payment/retry.py
--- a/src/payment/retry.py
+++ b/src/payment/retry.py
@@ -43,9 +43,7 @@ def retry_request(payment, policy):
 def retry_request(payment, policy):
     for attempt in range(policy.max_attempts):
-        if gateway.already_charged(payment.idempotency_key):
-            return gateway.last_result(payment.idempotency_key)
         result = gateway.charge(payment)
         if result.ok:
             return result
         sleep(policy.backoff(attempt))
     raise RetryExhausted(payment)
gold_patch:
diff --git a/src/payment/retry.py b/src/payment/retry.py
--- a/src/payment/retry.py
+++ b/src/payment/retry.py
@@ -43,7 +43,9 @@ def retry_request(payment, policy):
 def retry_request(payment, policy):
     for attempt in range(policy.max_attempts):
+        if gateway.already_charged(payment.idempotency_key):
+            return gateway.last_result(payment.idempotency_key)
         result = gateway.charge(payment)
         if result.ok:
             return result
         sleep(policy.backoff(attempt))
     raise RetryExhausted(payment)

diff --git a/tests/test_retry_idempotency.py b/tests/test_retry_idempotency.py
new file mode 100644

+++ b/tests/test_retry_idempotency.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+from payment.retry import retry_request
+from tests.fakes import FakeGateway, FlakyPolicy, make_payment
+
+
+def test_retry_is_idempotent(monkeypatch):
+    gateway = FakeGateway(fail_first=1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("payment.retry.gateway", gateway)
+    payment = make_payment(amount=100)
+
+    retry_request(payment, FlakyPolicy(max_attempts=3))
+    retry_request(payment, FlakyPolicy(max_attempts=3))
+    assert gateway.charges_for(payment.idempotency_key) == 1
